<!-- GENERATED from harness/commands/verify.md by `bin/harness sync` — do not edit this file. -->

Run the verification ladder for the current state of the tree.

- No argument → `zsh verify/all.sh`.
- A rung name → that rung, e.g. `zsh verify/quick.sh`, `zsh verify/build.sh`.
- `tests <pattern>` → `zsh verify/tests.sh <pattern>`, a vitest file filter such
  as a tool id (`zsh verify/tests.sh base64-text`).

`smoke` serves whatever is in `out/`, so run `build` first if the code changed
since the last build. A dev server may be running; building beside it is fine,
and a server you did not start is not yours to stop.

Report in this shape and nothing longer:

```text
<rung> → pass|fail (<number or message>)
```

For a failure, add three lines: the exact message, the real cause, and the
smallest change that would fix it. Do not fix it unless asked — this command
verifies.
